profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
## Core Competencies ##

Fluency: Microsoft Azure services (Azure Active Directory B2C, Azure Storage, CosmosDB, Azure DevOps, Redis, Kusto, Geneva, EAP, and so much more), cloud computing/architecture and livesite management, full-stack software design/development, software architecture/refactoring, behavior- and test-driven development, Agile development methodologies, engineering team management, developer evangelism/advocacy, open source project/community management, technical writing, C#, .Net Framework, MSBuild, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, NodeJS, Microservices and REST API development (incl. SSO, OAuth2, etc), IIS, Apache, MySQL, Nginx, Memcached, Git

• Seasoned technologist with a driving passion for understanding and helping people as well as creating, shaping and delivering products and services that don’t just fit their requirements but delight them
• A trusted engineer and technical advisor with over 25 years of front-line, hands-on experience enabling and improving online collaboration, communication and sharing for everyone from individual creators to global Enterprise companies and organizations
• Natural communicator, team builder and problem solver with a keen, analytical mind and a life-long addiction to learning, sharing knowledge and helping the people around me become the best they can be.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Excited to be returning to individual contribution for the IDNA Networking team which is part of the Identity Buildout Service. We are responsible for build out, automation and maintainance of networks (capacity, security, auditing, and governance) for Microsoft Identity services as Azure expands into new regions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
positions.description: Bootstrapping the Fundamentals and Infrastructure ("Funfrastructure") team, a sub-team within the Entra External ID (née Azure Active Directory B2X) team, improving our inner and outer loop development processes (dev UX/velocity, build/test, CI/CD), our team's security/compliance initiatives and livesite operation/management (infrastructure, scalability, telemetry, monitoring, alerting and on-call engineering processes and tools).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on Azure Active Directory B2X (B2C + B2B), within Azure Identity including DevOps/livesite management of the AADB2X service.  I've served as one the team's two Security Champions, our Fundamentals area contractor, our leading advocate for documentation and developer education/cross-training as well as our go-to subject matter expert for dev/on-call engineer tooling, build/test/deploy, telemetry/monitoring/alerting, on-call engineering processes and incident management as well as all of our service's infrastructure.

positions.title: Principal and Chief Architect
positions.description:
Endevver was an boutique I.T. consulting firm I founded with deliberate focus on performing the highest quality of service and creating lasting high-touch client relationships. Past customers include as Genentech, FedEx, Wells Fargo, Adobe, Rainbow Media (IFC, AMC, et al), HID Global, Talking Points Memo, ZDNet, The Chicago Tribune, The Daily Beast, Zap2It, Providence Journal, Harvard Business Review, and many more. We provided services such as (but not limited to) the following:

* Strategy consultation, needs assessment and selection of tools/services
* Custom application development, customization, integration and deployment
* Best practices configuration, deployment, administration and customization of popular content management systems (CMS) such as Wordpress, Movable Type, Drupal, etc
* Infrastructure/database architecture design and implementation
* Systems integration with third-party web services (e.g. Salesforce, Google, SSO/authentication, CRM, etc)
* Website design and development
* Security and performance audits
* System administration services  (Linux or AWS)
* Creation of technical white papers on relevant technologies as well as creation and execution of education/training curriculums for client staff

In my role as Principal, I brought together trusted independent contractors from my network to create cross-functional teams tailored to the needs of each project. As Chief Architect, I mentored, shaped and led these teams from project discovery through delivery. As a generalist with a wide breadth of experience in many areas, significant depth in some and a love for getting my hands dirty, I usually worked right alongside my teams with the goal of ensuring that our clients were always satisfied.

Fluency with full-stack web & software testing/design/development/architecture/refactoring, Agile, OSS  project/community management, Git, React, NodeJS, Microservices and REST API development, AWS, Apache, MySQL, Nginx, Memcached, Redis and more

positions.title: Application Architect
positions.description: Textura Design was a small consultancy working with Fortune 500 companies on areas of strategy, implementation and website/software customization related to blogging.  As Application Architect, I was responsible for the technical direction of the company and all of its projects.

positions.title: Product Manager, Movable Type and MT Enterprise
positions.description:
• Twelfth employee hired and Movable Type's first product manager after three years of design and development by its creators
• Oversaw design, development, QA/beta testing and release of Movable Type versions 3.2.x through 4.3.x
• Responsible for the creation and release of Movable Type Enterprise which quickly gained massive market share among large publishers, Enterprise companies and universities.

positions.title: Independent Consultant
positions.description: While traveling/living abroad, I continued work as a freelance web developer making heavy use of Movable Type—a newly released blogging platform—as a site-wide CMS and PHP for dynamic elements. Notable clients included Adaptive Path, Mule Design, 826 Valencia, JadFair.net, the Interaction Design Institute - Ivrea (Italy), and many others.

positions.title: Director of Product Management
positions.description:
During my tenure at i-drive, I held many roles, nearly all of which were newly created positions that needed someone to jump-start them and create order out of chaos—a recurring theme in my career.

• Technical Lead - Music/Entertainment products
• Manager, Business Development
• Director of product management - Demand Management
• Director of product management - Core Products

Immediately after the acquisition, I led the project responsible for integrating thedigs.com streaming jukebox technology and MP3.com integration (a feature we coined as "sideloading") into i-drive's product. Once that was complete, I joined the Business Development team in an effort to secure new music-related partners in addition MP3.com, RealNetworks and scour.net gained through acquisition.

In large part because of the popularity of these new features, site usage went through the roof and so did abuse. In response, I was chosen to create and run a new group called "Demand Management"  responsible for controlling system abuse by users who had created methods of automated system access.  My group oversaw development of technical protection measures such as first commercially deployed CAPTCHA, a system of opaque, dynamic bandwidth allocation and system management interfaces. In the end, our work saved i-drive over $10 million/year in bandwidth and disk storage costs. 

I was then tapped to lead the new "core products" group in charge of abstracting our core underlying technology stack from our website and encapsulating it into a platform upon which partners could build their own branded storage solutions.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer
positions.description:
thedigs.com was a social networking startup focused on the teen and college market in which each user profile was modeled after a "virtual dorm room" that could be decorated to show off their owner's personality and affinities.

Working with a very small but dedicated and talented team, we added a music component to the product in the form of the Internet's first online (Winamp-style) jukebox into which users could upload their favorite MP3s which could then be streamed by visitors to their profile.  It took off like wildfire leading to our pivot into a "music community", partnerships with MP3.com and RealNetworks and eventual acquisition by online storage startup i-drive.com.

positions.title: Director of Technology
positions.description: Startups.com was a service provider created to help streamline the process new and/or incubated startup companies went through to build out their initial office and technology infrastructure.  As Director of Technology, I helped define the array of solutions we provided for client companies (which included Google, Evite, and others) such as hosting, connectivity and infrastructure for both their internal and external networks, office telephony solutions and employee PCs and laptops.

positions.title: Senior System Administrator
positions.description:
• Promoted to Senior System Administrator to fill a critical need created by the departure of both of my predecessors in rapid succession.
• Successfully took charge of managing 50+ servers and other infrastructure running the largest online yellow pages site on the web.
• Standardized and automated most DevOps processes (monitoring, maintenance, deployment, etc) and created documentation for the entire system
• Trained a team of additional Senior System Administrators to take over for me before moving to San Francisco

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Created a business-critical application which connected their online advertising sales system to their parent company's billing system for the very first time. This now instantaneous and automated billing process had previously been entirely manual, labor-intensive, error-prone and slow, taking upwards of 5-7 business days to complete.

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.description: I created the Intercollegiate Sailing Association's (http://collegesailing.org/; then the Intercollegiate Yacht Racing Association or ICYRA) first website and continued developing/managing it for three years

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin

volunteerExperiences.description: This volunteer position has been one of the most formative and personally rewarding "jobs" I've ever had. During my long tenure as a Ranger—in addition to my normal duties described perfectly at http://rangers.burningman.org/what-do-rangers-do/—I've also served on the Ranger Operations Team, as a Ranger Mentor, a Green Dot (and Green Dot Long in charge of year-round event preparation for the Green Dots as well as an on-playa liaison and resources coordinator for all critical on-playa incidents requiring mental health professionals) and co-created the Ranger Sandman team. Most of these teams are described on http://rangers.burningman.org/ranger-teams/
